changelog:
- Complete Opera-Style Dark Theme VPN UI: Redesigned VPN dashboard with world map silhouette, central power control with glowing radar indicator, virtual location selector, and Fokk Pro Privacy banner.
- Zero-Drop Adaptive Web Routing: In-app adaptive forwarder connects to privacy nodes with instant direct bridge fallback so pages NEVER fail to load or timeout on Indian mobile networks (Jio 5G/Airtel).
- Clean Virtual Location Selector: Choose between Optimal location, America, Europe, Asia, or custom private servers without emojis.
- Browser Preferences: Added toggles for 'Use VPN for private tabs only' and 'Bypass VPN for search' engines.
